no_log_activity: mean 20 raw slab activities, then scale over 238 compositions to [-1,0]
log_activity: ln every slab activity, mean 20 log values, then scale over 238 compositions to [-1,0]
cemc_temperature_selection: one of 18 temperatures per trial minimizing equal-weight normalized ideal distance
representative_trial_constraint: none; representative trial is selected from the globally highest-probability KDE bin
continuous_recall: At each top-k fraction through 60%, intersection of the experimental and representative-trial top-k activity sets divided by k; ascending scaled activity rank
continuous_recall_baseline: expected random overlap, y = x in fraction units
